entries.en: The Powder Ghast is a mob that spawns, randomly in Dwarven Mines. It's not a part of the regular cycle, and instead is a random occurrence. The Powder Ghast can spawn in one of the following locations: Divan's Gateway, Rampart's Quarry, Cliffside Veinsand Forge Basin. The Powder Ghast is immune to melee damage. Players will receive, %1$s Mithril Powder for every hit that lands on its hitbox.

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每次钓鱼时，记得用上某种鱼饵。

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: You can store Bait in your inventory or Bait Sacks, which are unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 鱼饵可以放在物品栏里，也可以放进鱼饵收纳袋，后者在生鳕鱼收集 III 解锁。

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每次抛竿都会自动消耗鱼饵，用起来很方便！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: I craft Fish Bait all the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of Raw Cod and a Raw Salmon!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 我总是自己合成鱼饵，因为太简单了——只要几条生鳕鱼和一条生鲑鱼！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Here, I've got some spare Fish Bait for ya!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 来，我这儿有些多余的鱼饵送你！
你领取了鱼饵！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: Fish Bait seems to give a really effective  Fishing Speed boost!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 鱼饵似乎能非常有效地提升  钓鱼速度！
skyblock:FISH_BAIT

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: All Baits serve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 每种鱼饵都有专门的用途，所以随时都要带上一些！

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 如果你对鱼饵有任何疑问，随时可以查看我的鱼饵指南！
丰收盛宴

entries.en: [NPC] Angler Angus: You can also use /bait as a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!
entries.zh: [NPC] 垂钓者安格斯: 如果你懒得来找我，也可以用 /bait 快捷打开！

entries.en: Bait can be stored in your inventory
entries.zh: 鱼饵可以放在物品栏里，

entries.en: or Bait Sacks, which are unlocked at Raw Cod III.
entries.zh: 也可以放进鱼饵收纳袋，后者在生鳕鱼 III 解锁。

entries.en: When you cast your rod, Bait is automatically consumed and its buff is applied.
entries.zh: 抛竿时会自动消耗鱼饵并获得其增益效果。

entries.en: Some Baits, like Fish Bait, increase your  Fishing Speed, which makes it quicker to catch fish.
entries.zh: 部分鱼饵（如「鱼饵」）可以提高你的  钓鱼速度，让你更快钓到鱼。

entries.en: Other Baits, like Spiked Bait, make you more likely to catch Sea Creatures.
entries.zh: 其他鱼饵（如尖刺鱼饵）则能让你更容易钓到海怪。

entries.en: Fishing with Bait makes fishing easier, so keep plenty on hand!
entries.zh: 用鱼饵钓鱼会轻松很多，所以多备一些吧！

entries.en: Cave Dweller Family Two Howling Spirits have never been known to have the same howl.
entries.zh: 洞穴居民系列从来没有两只嚎叫之灵发出过相同的嚎叫。

entries.en: Trash Lover Family What else is the ocean if not the largest, deepest, most bountiful dumpster of them all?
entries.zh: 垃圾爱好者系列海洋如果不是世上最大、最深、最丰饶的垃圾桶，那还能是什么？

entries.en: Lapis Family These undead creatures are drawn to the energy of the lapis, their eerie blue glow illuminating the dark caverns.
entries.zh: 青金石系列这些亡灵生物被青金石的能量所吸引，它们诡异的蓝光照亮了黑暗的洞窟。

entries.en: They have a unique symbiotic relationship with the swamp flora, helping to keep the water clean and clear.
entries.zh: 它们与沼泽植物形成了独特的共生关系，帮助保持水体清洁清澈。

entries.en: Bug and Trash Lover Family Seldom seen, always heard.
entries.zh: 虫类与垃圾爱好者系列鲜少得见，常闻其声。

entries.en: Bogged can launch enchanted arrows through the water with deadly precision, their attacks swift and silent.
entries.zh: 沼骸能在水中射出附魔箭矢，精准致命，攻击迅捷而无声。
提供 %1$s→+%2$s  海怪几率。

entries.en: Spider Family These predatory arachnids are known for their insatiable appetite, devouring anything that crosses their path with alarming speed.
entries.zh: 蜘蛛系列这些掠食性的蛛形生物以贪得无厌的胃口著称，会以惊人的速度吞噬挡在它们路上的一切。

entries.en: Shulker Family Hideongift disguises itself as a festive present, its colorful shell mimicking the wrapping of a gift box.
entries.zh: 潜影贝系列匿礼虫会把自己伪装成一份节日礼物，色彩缤纷的外壳模仿着礼盒的包装。

entries.en: They are voracious feeders, often found near berry bushes where they munch on fallen berries and algae.
entries.zh: 它们食量惊人，常常出没在浆果丛附近，啃食掉落的浆果和藻类。

entries.en: Frog and Amphibian Family When threatened, the Tadgang has the unique ability to group together, merging their tiny forms to transform into a large, formidable frog.
entries.zh: 青蛙与两栖系列受到威胁时，蝌蚪帮拥有一种独特的能力：聚集在一起，将微小的身躯融为一体，化身为一只巨大而可怕的青蛙。

entries.en: Crime Family Gotta see off the competition Hitman Cooldown (Global)
entries.zh: 罪犯系列得把竞争对手都打发掉杀手冷却 (全局)

entries.en: Bird Family Harpies have a wingspan of up to %1$s meters, their powerful wings enabling swift, agile flight and sudden, deadly dives.
entries.zh: 鸟类系列鹰身女妖的翼展可达 %1$s米，强健的双翼让它们能够迅捷灵活地飞行，并发动突然而致命的俯冲。

entries.en: A silent tiller revered for its unseen but vital role in the life cycle of the earth.
entries.zh: 一位沉默的耕耘者，因其在大地生命循环中看不见却至关重要的作用而备受尊崇。
花园访客到来的速度 %1$s%→+%2$s%加快。

entries.en: Lotusfish follow a strict diet consisting only of the various lotuses found around the Atoll.
entries.zh: 莲花鱼严格遵循一套食谱，只吃环礁周围的各种莲花。

entries.en: These undead creatures are driven by an insatiable greed, forever seeking out precious metals and jewels.
entries.zh: 这些亡灵生物受到永不满足的贪欲驱使，永远在搜寻贵金属和珠宝。

entries.en: Known for their agile movements, they dart between submerged roots and plants with ease.
entries.zh: 它们以灵活的身姿著称，能在水下的树根和植物之间轻松穿梭。

entries.en: These ethereal beings can create dense fog, obscuring vision and muffling sound.
entries.zh: 这些缥缈的生灵能制造浓雾，遮蔽视线、掩盖声响。

entries.en: This unusual blaze confounds its enemies with its disorienting appearance, attacking from unexpected angles.
entries.zh: 这种奇特的烈焰人以令人晕头转向的外表迷惑敌人，从意想不到的角度发起攻击。

entries.en: Bug Family A particularly large and intimidating beetle, though it spends most of its time fighting other Stag Beetles.
entries.zh: 虫类系列一种体型格外庞大、令人生畏的甲虫，不过它大部分时间都在和其他锹形虫打架。

entries.en: Squid Family A silent guardian of the sky, its vast wings are a tranquil spectacle, often seen soaring high above with a serene grace.
entries.zh: 鱿鱼系列天空中沉默的守护者，它宽大的双翼是一道宁静的奇景，常常可见它在高空翱翔，姿态安详优雅。

entries.en: Yogs bounce menacingly through the fiery depths, their magma-like bodies radiating intense heat.
entries.zh: 尤格在炽热的深处气势汹汹地弹跳，它们岩浆般的身体散发出强烈的热量。

entries.en: These nocturnal hunters are masters of stealth, using their acute hearing to pinpoint the location of their prey.
entries.zh: 这些夜行猎手是潜行大师，凭借敏锐的听觉精确定位猎物的位置。

entries.en: Reptile and Lizard Family These amphibious creatures can regenerate lost limbs.
entries.zh: 爬行动物与蜥蜴系列这些两栖生物能够再生失去的肢体。

entries.en: These undead workers are driven by an insatiable need to mine, endlessly chipping away at the rock with their rusty tools.
entries.zh: 这些亡灵工人受到永不满足的挖矿欲望驱使，用生锈的工具没完没了地敲凿岩石。

entries.en: Born blind, Flitters often spend their entire lives flying in the same direction. Because of this, they can end up just about anywhere.
entries.zh: 翩飞虫生来失明，常常一生都朝着同一个方向飞行。正因如此，它们几乎可能出现在任何地方。
